#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read-only supplemental archive audit; never extract members to disk."""
import gzip
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import tarfile

ARCHIVE = Path('/Users/rex/Desktop/personal/lutriva/evals/records/2026-09-08-feedback-loop/cycle-10.tar.gz')
INVENTORY = ARCHIVE.with_name('cycle-10-inventory.json')
EXPECTED_ARCHIVE = '107054faa0f3e7216128ccb45919af838704dfc4e4f5617bd0e303a3f2fc1924'
EXPECTED_INVENTORY = '9dafdd9ef3c9a25b4bb8f5657eb435ac6a80ef84dbd17b0e92e214822141251d'
CHUNK = 1024 * 1024

def digest(stream):
    size = 0
    sha = hashlib.sha256()
    while True:
        block = stream.read(CHUNK)
        if not block:
            break
        size += len(block)
        sha.update(block)
    return {'bytes': size, 'sha256': sha.hexdigest()}

def abbreviate(order):
    return ''.join(value[-1] for value in order)

report = {'mode': 'read-only archive member streams; no extraction, browser, or replay', 'checks': [], 'historicalLogs': []}

def check(name, condition, details=None):
    report['checks'].append({'name': name, 'pass': bool(condition), 'details': details})

for name, path, expected in [('archive', ARCHIVE, EXPECTED_ARCHIVE), ('inventory', INVENTORY, EXPECTED_INVENTORY)]:
    with path.open('rb') as stream:
        actual = digest(stream)
    report[name] = actual
    check(name + ' SHA matches handoff', actual['sha256'] == expected)

with tarfile.open(ARCHIVE, 'r:*') as archive:
    members = {member.name: member for member in archive.getmembers()}

    def read(name):
        with archive.extractfile(name) as stream:
            return stream.read()

    def read_json(name):
        return json.loads(read(name))

    records = [json.loads(line) for line in read('work/evidence-compression.jsonl').decode().splitlines()]
    verified = [row for row in records if row['status'] == 'verified-before-removal']
    removed = [row for row in records if row['status'] == 'uncompressed-copy-removed-recoverable']
    check('compression ledger has exactly 18 verification/removal pairs', len(records) == 36 and len(verified) == len(removed) == 18)
    check('verification sources are unique', len({row['source'] for row in verified}) == 18)
    check('removal sources are unique and match verified', len({row['source'] for row in removed}) == 18 and {row['source'] for row in removed} == {row['source'] for row in verified})
    expected_gz = set()
    for row in verified:
        prefix = '/tmp/lutriva-queue-observer-RAcypp/'
        if not row['source'].startswith(prefix) or row['compressed'] != row['source'] + '.gz':
            raise ValueError('Unexpected historical source mapping: ' + repr(row))
        member_name = 'observer/' + row['compressed'][len(prefix):]
        expected_gz.add(member_name)
        removal = next(item for item in removed if item['source'] == row['source'])
        paired = removal['compressed'] == row['compressed'] and records.index(row) < records.index(removal)
        with archive.extractfile(member_name) as stream:
            compressed = digest(stream)
        with archive.extractfile(member_name) as stream:
            with gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=stream, mode='rb') as decoded:
                original = digest(decoded)
        result = {'member': member_name, 'decoded': original, 'compressed': compressed, 'originalMatchesLedger': original == row['original'], 'gzipMatchesLedger': compressed == row['gzip'], 'removalFollowsVerification': paired, 'uncompressedMemberAbsent': member_name[:-3] not in members}
        report['historicalLogs'].append(result)
        check('historical log verified: ' + member_name, all(result[key] for key in ['originalMatchesLedger', 'gzipMatchesLedger', 'removalFollowsVerification', 'uncompressedMemberAbsent']))
    actual_gz = {name for name, member in members.items() if member.isfile() and name.endswith('.gz')}
    check('all and only 18 historical gzip members covered', expected_gz == actual_gz and len(actual_gz) == 18)
    report['decodedHistoricalBytes'] = sum(row['decoded']['bytes'] for row in report['historicalLogs'])
    check('decoded historical byte total matches cycle conclusion', report['decodedHistoricalBytes'] == 165322198)

    scope_members = sorted(name for name, member in members.items() if member.isfile() and name.startswith('scope-controls/'))
    report['scopeControlsMembers'] = scope_members
    check('selected scope-control archive matches README disclosure', scope_members == ['scope-controls/REPORT.md', 'scope-controls/evidence.json', 'scope-controls/run-controls.mjs'])
    readme = read('archive-tools/ARCHIVE-README.md').decode()
    report['readmeDisclosures'] = {name: phrase in readme for name, phrase in {
        'selectedControlTreesOmitted': 'Synthetic control directory trees (including an intentional symlink) are not included',
        'noRelocatedReplay': 'An archive-relocated browser replay was NOT performed',
        'supplementAbsoluteImport': 'review/recovery-supplement.mjs imports the original /tmp/lutriva-queue-observer-RAcypp path',
        'futureAdapterRequiresNewFreeze': 'a future relocation requires an explicitly recorded adapter/new freeze',
        'partialENOSPCEvidencePreserved': 'Invalid partial04 JSON is deliberately not repaired',
        'noTranscriptTruthClaim': 'not proof of every observation or the unavailable full agent transcript',
    }.items()}
    check('required archive-scope and absolute-path limits disclosed', all(report['readmeDisclosures'].values()))

    report['fixedOutcomes'] = {}
    for label, member_name in [('baseline', 'observer/baseline-attempt-05/browser.json'), ('candidate', 'work/candidate-observer-01/browser.json')]:
        data = read_json(member_name)
        report['fixedOutcomes'][label] = {'scenarios': [{'name': row['name'], 'outcome': row['outcome'], 'failedAssertions': len(row['failed']), 'notRun': row['notRun']} for row in data['scenarioResults']], 'errors': data['errors'], 'runtimeErrors': data['runtimeErrors'], 'sourceUnchanged': data['sourceUnchanged'], 'samples': sum(len(row['timeline']) for row in data['scenarios'])}
        if label == 'candidate':
            focus = next(row for row in data['scenarios'] if row['name'] == '07-keyboard-wide')['timeline'][5]
            report['residualFocusEvidence'] = {'label': focus['label'], 'sequence': focus['sequence'], 'job': focus['active']['jobId'], 'action': focus['active']['action'], 'bottom': focus['active']['rect']['bottom'], 'viewportHeight': focus['viewport']['height'], 'outline': focus['active']['style']['outline'], 'outlineOffset': focus['active']['style']['outlineOffset']}

    report['supplementOutcomes'] = {}
    for label in ['original', 'trial']:
        data = read_json('review/supplement-' + label + '-01/report.json')
        report['supplementOutcomes'][label] = {'kind': data['kind'], 'exitCode': data['exitCode'], 'errors': data['errors'], 'runtimeErrors': data['runtimeErrors'], 'sourceUnchanged': data['sourceUnchanged'], 'failedAssertions': [row['name'] for row in data['checks'] if row['status'] == 'fail'], 'finalOrder': abbreviate(data['states'][-1]['order']), 'finalStoredOrder': abbreviate(data['states'][-1]['storedOrder'])}
    baseline = report['fixedOutcomes']['baseline']
    candidate = report['fixedOutcomes']['candidate']
    check('archived fixed scenario outcomes match independently observed results', [row['outcome'] for row in baseline['scenarios']] == ['pass', 'fail', 'fail', 'fail', 'fail', 'pass', 'fail', 'fail'] and [row['outcome'] for row in candidate['scenarios']] == ['pass', 'pass', 'pass', 'fail', 'pass', 'pass', 'human-review-or-not-run', 'human-review-or-not-run'])
    check('archived sample totals match cycle conclusion', baseline['samples'] == 691 and candidate['samples'] == 530)
    check('archived supplemental outcomes match independently observed results', report['supplementOutcomes']['original']['exitCode'] == 1 and report['supplementOutcomes']['trial']['exitCode'] == 0 and report['supplementOutcomes']['original']['finalOrder'] == '124356' and report['supplementOutcomes']['trial']['finalOrder'] == '134256')
    focus = report['residualFocusEvidence']
    check('archived residual focus geometry preserved', focus['job'] == 'JOB-1045' and focus['action'] == 'up' and focus['bottom'] == 900.453125 and focus['viewportHeight'] == 900)
    report['independentReviewArchivedSHA256'] = hashlib.sha256(read('review/REVIEW.md')).hexdigest()
    report['partialAttempt04Present'] = 'observer/baseline-attempt-04/browser.json' in members

report['verdict'] = 'verified within stated checks' if all(row['pass'] for row in report['checks']) else 'mismatch'
report['limits'] = 'Byte recovery and archived-record consistency only; no extraction, relocated replay, new observation, complete transcript reconstruction, or proof of general skill quality.'
print(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
sys.exit(0 if report['verdict'] == 'verified within stated checks' else 1)
